Heard on I.A.No.13470/2024, first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail
sentence and grant of bail on behalf of appellant - Shivcharan.
2.

This Criminal Appeal has been preferred under Section 374 of the Cr.P.C. against the judgment of
conviction and order of sentence dated 24.06.2024 passed by First Additional Sessions Judge
Karera, District Shivpuri (Madhya Pradesh) in Case No.16/2021, whereby present appellant has
been convicted under Section 376(1) of Ipc and sentenced to undergo 10 years Ri with fine of
Rs.1000/- with default stipulation.

First Additional Sessions Judge

sentences.text: 3.  It is the submission of counsel for the appellant that appellant has falsely been implicated in the crime and learned trial Court has erred in awarding jail sentence to the appellant without appreciating the material in right perspective.
Appellant has already suffered 14 months of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.
Learned counsel for appellant further submits that there is material contradiction in the statements of prosecutrix.
As per opinion of doctor, no external or internal injury has been found over the proseuctrix.
Prosecutrix is a married lady and it is a case of consent.
No case is made out for offence under Section 376 (1) of IPC.
During trial appellant was on bail, but he did not misuse the liberty so granted.
Hearing of appeal will take time and the appellant has good 2 CRA-7820-2024 case on merits.
He further undertakes to abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Therefore, he may also be given the benefit of suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer made by the counsel for the appellant and prays for rejection of application.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties and going through the record couple with the facts that final hearing of the appeal is likely to take some time, therefore, in considered opinion of this Court, the I.A.No.13470/2024 is allowed Shivcharan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140460899/
1 and it is ordered that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)
with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, the jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended till disposal of this appeal and he be released on bail subject to deposit of fine, if not already deposited.
